title: Persistent thesis book instead of rebuilding ledger every run
problem: Ledger is rebuilt from scratch each run so the hand-off churns: 96 dropped / 85 new of 154/143 while 96% of ledger tickers carry; 66 of 85 new were already in the previous ledger.
proposed_fix: Carry each thesis by a stable key until invalidation, target, time stop or explicit replacement; hand-off and triage become deltas (NEW/STATE_CHANGED/CARRIED/RETIRED with reason).

title: Signed trigger distance: keep theses that closed through the trigger

proposed_fix: Use signed distance with a new TRIGGERED_BEYOND_CHASE state kept in the hand-off with a pullback re-entry criterion; flag when Vanguard still says WAIT_TRIGGER after a close beyond the trigger.

title: Freshness cliff: READY theses age out after 4 business days
problem: fresh_from = evidence - 4 business days while median q50 is 16 sessions; 35 READY_FRESH went READY_OLD_EVENT and were dropped, including held/carded BILI, OI, USAR, UTI.
proposed_fix: Measure freshness against the thesis clock (inside q50/2 sessions and price inside chase limit or before half target); always carry carded, ordered or held names.

title: No hysteresis on the 0.5 / 1.0 ATR trigger windows
problem: 52 WAIT_0.5ATR names went FAR in one session and 42 of the 85 new names came back into 0.5 ATR from 1ATR/FAR.
proposed_fix: Enter the window at 0.5 ATR and leave only beyond 1.5 ATR away or at invalidation.

title: Thesis re-anchoring: governing thesis re-selected and re-dated each run
problem: 916 of 2,183 carried tickers keep setup+timeframe but get a new thesis_id (anchor median +1 day); 15% change setup/timeframe; 21 READY_FRESH demoted to WAIT_TRIGGER_FAR with a new trigger (CDE, DNN, EWG).
proposed_fix: Thesis identity = ticker+side+setup+timeframe+campaign start; Vanguard keeps an adopted governing thesis until invalidated and a replacement names what it replaced and why.

title: Focus gate re-evaluated daily on inputs that flip
problem: Ledger focus: 241 kept, 173 lost, 158 gained; of 173 lost: trigger window 64, thesis replaced 50, rr<1 24, aged out 17, intraday checks 14, side flip 4.
proposed_fix: Judge focus at thesis birth; afterwards demote only on invalidation-type evidence.
